d:
The images and vids on this page are part of a picture audio book!

You can find the book here:

http://www.tooshoes.net/chattel_girl.html

This is the full audio book with AI images displayed along the way. The story was published originally in 2018 (so that part is fully human generated).

This story loosely follows the plot of the Supergirl TV pilot in another universe before it dives off the deep end.

If the short first chapter and the images here don't win you over, then this story may not be for you.

But this story has a lot of elements in common with my other stories here, so if you like those, you should give this a chance.

While the audio book is complete, I will frequently be adding images to fill in the empty spaces over time.
